candidates.snippet: Monitoring channels report that the Ukrainian Defence Forces have struck the Omsk Oil Refinery, the largest oil refinery in the Russian Federation. https://t.co/Aca5TypZYJ

Russian media are reporting that a major internet outage has occurred in Russia. There are reports of problems accessing websites, online services, banks and media outlets. Some services claim that the problems arose following an attack on the Yandex data centre. https://t.co/K7p
